## Overview
Build a practical Spanish vocabulary with a flashcard deck designed for busy adults. This set covers 500 everyday words, each presented with an example sentence that shows how the word is used in real conversation. A built-in spaced review schedule helps you revisit words at the right time, so new vocabulary moves from short-term recognition to lasting memory.

## Highlights
- 500 everyday words selected for real-life situations
- Example sentence on every card for context-based learning
- Spaced review schedule that reinforces words at optimal intervals
- Designed for adult learners who want steady, efficient progress
